items.text: Its got a lot of bugs. A tendency for the cops to ricochet off my craft while docked which sometimes hurls me into space. Usually at k-leg there are dead bodies all around. Other than that its great to patch up a ship and restore its systems. However it would be easier to navigate if I could set an exact bearing for my craft.
items.text_zh: 它有很多bug。警察有一种倾向，会在我的飞船停靠时从我的飞船上弹开，有时会把我甩进太空。通常在k-leg周围到处都是尸体。除此之外，修补飞船并恢复其系统很棒。不过，如果我能为我的飞船设定一个精确的方位，导航会更容易。

observations.evidence: Usually at k-leg there are dead bodies all around.
observations.evidence_zh: 通常在k-leg周围到处都是尸体。
